edit.old: Compare the file format, mesh and preview of each USA product before purchasing. A terrain-model package and a set of individual state models are separate product choices. If you need a particular geographic area, check the product preview and confirm the required coverage before ordering.
edit.text:
Choose by the supplied formats and whether you need a terrain asset or separate state meshes. The collections below are separate products.

ProductSupplied model formatsModel and base
USA terrain package (this product)C4D and OBJ: LOD100, LOD50, LOD25Terrain model with material and texture files; open base.
50-state C4D collectionC4D; OBJ/FBX export on request50 separate state meshes with individual satellite textures; open base.
Contiguous 48-state collectionC4D and OBJ48 contiguous state meshes; closed base.
50-state STL collectionSTL50 state meshes with closed bases for print/CNC preparation.

LOD100, LOD50 and LOD25 identify detail versions of this terrain model; they do not mean sets of 100, 50 or 25 states.

Check the preview of each product for the geographic area shown. For printing or CNC, compare the STL collection and prepare the selected files for your machine and scale.
